title: AYGON.FUN
tagline: AYGON.FUN is an AI-powered battleground where you create and watch epic agent fights in real time. Built with Privy for seamless wallets, Gaia Node's knowledge base to power Judge and Hero AI for smarter decision-making. AFK mode? We have Covalent ZEE workflow to handle it.

description:
AYGON.fun is an AI-powered battleground where users can create custom heroes and watch them battle in real-time AI-generated fights. With just 100 characters, users can prompt their hero's identity, personality, and abilities, and our AI interprets, visualizes, and simulates the battles dynamically.

Key Features:
📝 Prompt-Based Hero Creation – Players type a short description (max 100 characters) to generate a unique AI-powered fighter.
⚖️ AI-Driven Battle Judging – The Judge AI analyzes hero stats, fight dynamics, and past performances to declare a winner with Gaia Node's knowledge base.
🏆 AFK Mode – Users can submit their heroes and let AI auto-battle asynchronously, with rankings handled by Covalent ZEE workflow.
🚀 Dynamic AI Learning – Our Gaia Node-powered knowledge base ensures that heroes and judges improve over time through battle data and Deepseek R1's knowledge synthesis.
🛡️ Seamless Web3 Integration – No complex onboarding; Privy handles wallets for an easy and secure login experience.
🌐 Fun, Social & Competitive – Users can challenge each other, vote on battles, and test their prompt engineering skills to create the ultimate hero.
how_its_made:
Aygon is built using React for a fast, interactive UI, with Motion handling smooth animations and transitions to enhance the user experience. The core battle system is powered by Gaia Node, where the Judge AI processes battle logs as a knowledge base using DeepSeek R1, allowing it to make dynamic, context-aware decisions. The AI determines battle outcomes based on hero prompts, evaluates past fights to refine its decision-making, and even selects appropriate sound effects for a more immersive experience.  

For data management, Prisma handles the backend database, efficiently storing user-generated heroes, battle results, and matchmaking data. This enables quick retrieval and updates, ensuring smooth gameplay. Privy is integrated to provide a frictionless wallet experience, allowing users to jump into battles instantly without manual wallet setups or signups.  

AFK Mode is powered by Covalent ZEE, automating the entire battle process while ensuring fair and competitive matchmaking. The AFK system operates by:  
•⁠  ⁠Fetching users who have enabled AFK mode.  
•⁠  ⁠Retrieving their available heroes and associated battle statistics.  
•⁠  ⁠Scanning for available battle rooms, prioritizing matches with opponents of similar strength.  
•⁠  ⁠Creating a new battle room if no suitable opponent is found.  
•⁠  ⁠Triggering AI battles and logging results for future learning by the Judge AI.  

With these integrations, Aygon offers a real-time, AI-driven battleground that continuously evolves, providing users with a seamless and engaging experience.
